title: readPLY
body:
## readPLY

Curated PLY reader: reads exactly one Stanford PLY file (ASCII or binary) into polydata, with vertex properties such as normals, colours or texture coordinates carried as arrays. PLY has no unit, so coordinates are in whatever unit the scanner or CAD tool used. Use it for scanned or meshed surfaces to render, clip or probe; use pvPLYReader for file series or texture settings, and readSTL for STL.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Check the coordinate unit (millimetres versus metres) against the simulation data before combining them; nothing is converted.

Native constructor: `PLYReader`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `files` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1,"maxItems":1}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "readPLY",
  "options": {
    "files": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
